segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or crepey under-eye skin report the cream feels hydrating and smooths crepiness, though a couple note it is less moisturizing than expected relative to its price.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe sensitive skin or sensitive/delicate eyes report no irritation, stinging, or milia, and appreciate the fragrance-free or near-scentless formula.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s to 70s report visible brightening and some firming of dark circles and fine lines, though results on deeper wrinkles are described as modest.
segments.combination: One reviewer with eczema-prone skin around the eyes reports the cream calms flare-ups and feels velvety without triggering breakouts.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers mention fine lines, crepeyness or loss of firmness and report smoother, plumper, firmer-looking skin after weeks of use; wrinkle reduction itself is described as slight or inconclusive by most.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe the cream as hydrating, non-greasy and good for dry under-eyes; one reviewer felt it was less moisturizing than other creams and had to alternate with a separate moisturizer.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers with sensitive or eczema-prone eye areas report no irritation, redness, or allergic reaction from use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically notes the cream is marketed to restore the skin barrier and reports agreement with that claim; no other reviewer discusses barrier function directly.
concerns.spots: Reviewers describe visible brightening of dark circles and evening of skin tone within one to three weeks; two long-term users (three months) report no change at all in dark circles.
concerns.oiliness: Nearly all reviewers describe the texture as non-greasy and quickly absorbed, with no reports of oiliness or breakouts.
